quests.title: Beginner enrollment
quests.hint: Talk to Enzu on the farm and accept beginner training. You can abandon anytime with no penalty.

quests.title: Slime hunt
quests.hint: South of the farm: kill 5 Slimes, then check Quest (F5).

quests.title: Dummy barracks
quests.hint: Find the Dummy Barracks on the farm. Practice hits on 3 Training Dummies (they do not chase). Tips: Shift+F10 → Farm Barracks.

quests.title: Visit your city
quests.hint: Use the farm portal into Aresden or Elvine and explore the city once.

quests.title: Mercenary warrior
quests.hint: Merc Barracks: kill 1 Mercenary Warrior. They chase like players — kite and don't tank free hits. Tips: Shift+F10 → Farm Barracks.

quests.title: Mercenary mage
quests.hint: Kill 1 Mercenary Mage. They cast Chill Wind + Energy Bolt — Chill them first, then commit. Full protocol tips: Shift+F10 → Farm Barracks.

quests.title: Attack protocol
quests.hint: Talk to the Merc Captain (or Training → Farm Barracks) and learn the attack protocol: Chill Wind → Paralyze → PFA/DS to deny PFM (when you have those spells).

quests.title: Huntzone intro
quests.hint: Reach a Hunt Zone (huntzone1–4) from the city dungeon or city gates. Explore the route once — mid farm comes next.

quests.title: Party awareness
quests.hint: Open F5 → Party and Create a party (or Join with a friend's code). Group hunting splits pressure on mid routes.

quests.title: Shop potions
quests.hint: Enter the city shop (areshop / elvshop) and buy any potion from the Shop Keeper (Red/Blue/Green).

quests.title: Mid farm
quests.hint: Kill 5 Clay Golems (city outskirts / mid routes). Stock potions first if needed.

quests.title: Dungeon gate
quests.hint: Enter your city dungeon once (Aresden Dungeon / Elvine Dungeon). Huntzones link through these floors.

quests.title: Lize drill
quests.hint: Enter the Training Arena world (training). Read Arena tips (Shift+F10): freeze → Lize → kite. Farm Barracks tips stay on the farm.

quests.title: EK awareness
quests.hint: Enemy Kills (±10): only count if the victim is within 10 levels below you (or higher). EK ledger is not live yet — kill 10 monsters as a farm milestone while you learn the rule. See docs/EK-LEDGER.md.

quests.title: Guild hint
quests.hint: Talk to Howard at the Guild Hall and Register guild interest. Full guild create/join comes later (Fase H).

quests.title: Middleland
quests.hint: Visit Middleland or Promiseland once. Bring potions; open-world PvP risk is real.

quests.title: Training preset
quests.hint: Enter world training, open Training (Shift+F10) → Arena, and Apply any chase preset. Server must spawn at least one dummy.

quests.title: Path complete
quests.hint: Return to Enzu on the farm and talk to close the 1→80 beginner path. Abandon was always free — training stays optional.
